primitiveBudget: one generated non-zero compound SVG path, one enclosing contour, three generated apertures, three gate markers, and four liftable winding inversions
commitThreshold: a continuous draw must cross the centre and release at the next clockwise gate
memoryRule: each accepted draw flips the next aperture's winding and re-produces a small enclosing crease; four inversions compound
interactionRule: pointer or touch draws gate-to-gate; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight selects, Enter/Space arms and commits; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: counterfield tiles, pressure block, and stroke glyph -> one filled non-zero compound SVG path with winding apertures
compositionRupture: distributed register, central block, and diagonal syntax -> one centred seal with three negative openings
encounterRupture: two-site attention, sustained pressure, and dwell/departure -> continuous cross-seal drag with clockwise constraint
temporalRupture: remote reply and additive strata -> winding parity that changes whether an aperture is mass or absence
mediumRupture: separate shapes and strokes -> actual compound path construction using contour orientation
changedRule: A valid clockwise cross-seal draw reverses the next aperture's winding and creases its enclosing contour; the resulting topology is generated by the compound path itself.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one dark angular seal with three apertures. Each accepted crossing turns one actual aperture from hole to mass or back and changes a nearby outer edge; four inversions compound.
falsifier: Delete if a short, same-gate, or counter-clockwise draw commits; if only colour/readout changes; if the compound path does not change; if later inversions reset; or if the blind seal reads as a generic logo or route diagram.
deletionCondition: Delete v048 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the winding seal from v045-v047 or if topology is only explanatory prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
